about: THE PROTOTYPE'S FIGURES, taken for SCRUM-271 (docs/progress/plans/offline/PLAN.md, Round 2:
"one calculator") from the till's own arithmetic immediately before it was deleted: apps/pos/src/lib/tax.ts
(computeTaxBreakdown, summarizeTax, roundTHB) and computeTotals (lib/sale.ts), computeFnbTotals and
computeLineTotal (lib/fnb.ts), computeMerchTotals and computeMerchLineTotal (lib/merch.ts), and the
reports in lib/reporting.ts as they stood, in baht floats, exactly as the screens received them.
The carts are test/support/parityCases.ts; the catalogue below is the till's seed at the time, and
the test hands it back to the store so a later edit to the seed cannot move a figure. Every amount
here is BAHT as the prototype computed it, unrounded; test/one-calculator-parity.test.ts converts each
to satang and compares it with the satang engine (packages/shared) as apps/pos/src/lib/cartWire.ts
now calls it. Where the two may differ, the case says so and why (parityCases.ts, `differs`).
NOT REGENERABLE by design: the arithmetic that produced these figures no longer exists. A new case
needs its prototype figure worked out from the prototype's code (imports/oto-pos/artifacts/oto-till,
the same files) — never taken from the engine it is meant to check.
